factual_methodology.summary: Confirmed BLS release Oct 16 import/export price aggregates, partner terms of trade and Eurostat final HICP breakdown, dates, component contributions and country rates using primary official releases; forecasts separated from observations.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Independent October 16 releases advance prior day's PPI/CPI story; causal argument, opposing evidence, non-additive quantities, limitations and end-of-text primary bibliography preserved in both languages.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Both locales contain exactly aligned numerical data across two BLS/Eurostat charts, three tables, one causal flow and one qualitative regional map.

research_depth.summary: Border cost shock, nonfuel import pressures, country-specific European energy inflation, terms of trade, monetary policy, Brazil, falsifiable scenarios and limits.

evidence_traceability.summary: Ten source URLs in each language across official BLS, Eurostat, ECB, IMF, IBGE and BEA publications; release and reference periods clearly stated.

counterfactual_review.summary: Tests temporary-price, broader-diffusion and margin/demand-compression scenarios; acknowledges nonfuel/import heterogeneity, EU country disparities, Canadian bilateral decline and uncertain pass-through.

contrary_evidence: US September bilateral terms of trade with Canada fell 0.3% despite aggregate export prices rising more than aggregate import prices.
Eurostat final headline 3.8% agrees with its early-October flash rate; the detailed breakdown is new, not an upward headline revision.
Some air-freight export prices fell month on month despite large positive year-on-year rates.
Price-index changes alone cannot prove transaction volumes, real income or sovereign credit events.
limitations: Neither US border prices nor the euro-area HICP reveal real trade quantities or causality by tariff/conflict/firm.
No intraday market quotation, foreign exchange move or sovereign bond-yield change asserted.
ECB and IMF values are dated projections rather than realized October observations.
QA conducted in this workflow, not independent external peer review.
notes: Primary-source fact and editorial QA with bilingual numerical and visual parity; tied to exact pending and staged Markdown blob hashes.
